description: This Java interface defines the TenantManagementService, which provides methods for managing tenants in a system, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting tenant configurations.

classes.name: TenantManagementService
classes.description: Interface for managing tenants, providing methods to add, read, update, and remove tenant information.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new tenant with provided tenant ID and configuration JSON, using a Span for tracing and a handler to process the result.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves tenant configuration information for a given tenant ID, with tracing span and handler for the result.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the configuration of an existing tenant identified by tenant ID and resource version, with tracing span and result handler.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tenant specified by tenant ID and resource version, using tracing span and handler for operation outcome.
